subject.title: feat: ask_user follow-ups — harness convergence, channel finalization + reactions, native cards, docked web panel

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this single PR’s broad all-surface follow-up scope now, including the docked web interaction, reaction answers, and native question cards, or split the rollout after the gateway/harness convergence?
rationale: The branch combines several independent user-facing product decisions across channels, mobile apps, and the Control UI; the supplied context says the web design had direction, but it does not establish equivalent maintainer approval for the whole bundled rollout.

options.title: Sponsor the integrated rollout
options.body: Keep the unified branch, after compatibility verification and live proof cover the channel and native surfaces.

options.title: Land the runtime convergence first
options.body: Split out the gateway/harness and SDK-safe core path, then review channel and native presentation changes as smaller follow-ups.

options.title: Pause for product narrowing
options.body: Hold the PR until an owner confirms which presentation surfaces belong in the immediate release.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the integrated rollout
recommendation.body: Keep the unified branch, after compatibility verification and live proof cover the channel and native surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied merged-feature and branch history make steipete the strongest available routing candidate for the question-system product boundary.
